category_title: Non-verbal male students with classic autism who struggle with functional communication and use tactile tracing for letter recognition
scenario_title: Developing functional communication and social cues
minimal_context: The student is sitting in the classroom and is asked to communicate his snack preference using a traditional communication device.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for a snack. Please tell me what you want to eat using your Springboard Lite device.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Presses buttons on the screen randomly, not using his device as a functional use of communication to select a snack.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you want to eat?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes a vocal sound but exhibits difficulty using natural speech to answer the question.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to tell me what you need.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains unable to use natural speech to meet his daily communication needs and pushes the device away without communicating a choice.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for a snack. Please tell me what you want to eat using your Springboard Lite device.

STUDENT: (Presses buttons on the screen randomly, not using his device as a functional use of communication to select a snack.)

TUTOR: What do you want to eat?

STUDENT: (Makes a vocal sound but exhibits difficulty using natural speech to answer the question.)

TUTOR: Try to tell me what you need.

STUDENT: (Remains unable to use natural speech to meet his daily communication needs and pushes the device away without communicating a choice.)

task.content: Meeting daily communication needs, teaching social messages, and exhibiting personal cues
task.learning_goal: Improve functional communication skills and independence

context.environment: Classroom setting for students with classic autism
context.materials: iPad tablet, picture-based applications (Proloquo2Go, Grace), Look2Learn, Stories2Learn
context.social_setting: Students with speech and language impairments serviced by a speech pathologist

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When attempting to meet daily communication needs

behavior_patterns.condition: When needing to communicate daily needs
When provided with traditional communication devices like Springboard Lite
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Not using his device as a functional use of communication
